themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Covers AI agents designed to perform research tasks autonomously or assist human researchers with complex workflows and data analysis.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Focuses on AI tools that aid developers in writing, debugging, and understanding code, accelerating the software development lifecycle.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Encompasses a broad category of AI-powered platforms and software designed to enhance various aspects of research, from data collection to analysis.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Details AI applications that condense large amounts of text or data into concise summaries, aiding in faster comprehension and insight extraction.

themes.name: AI-powered data analysis
themes.description: Explores how AI is used to analyze datasets, identify patterns, and derive actionable insights, often for business intelligence and decision-making.

themes.name: AI recruitment research
themes.description: Focuses on AI's role in the recruitment process, including candidate sourcing, resume screening, and impact analysis on the job market.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Covers the use of AI-generated simulated users or personas for testing, research, and data generation purposes.

themes.name: AI research tools comparison
themes.description: Articles that compare different AI tools for research, evaluating their features, performance, and suitability for specific tasks.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Examines how AI is integrated into the design process and user research methodologies to enhance creativity, efficiency, and user understanding.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Focuses on the research and development of AI chatbots, their capabilities, limitations, and impact on user interaction and information seeking.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
